    StartersSalsa and Salsa nachosCorn chips with black beans, melted cheddar, salsa and avocadoHow to make it2 bags of corn chips1 can black beans250g cheddar1 jar jalapenos2 avocados1 jar tomato salsa300ml sour creamDrain the beans, grate the cheddar and slice the jalapenos. Smash the avocado.Layer the chips on a tray with beans, cheese and jalapenos.Bake at 200°C until melted.Top with salsa, avocado and sour cream.Agnes's fairy princess star fairy breadSprinkled star bread, served by ZinkerbellHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft white bread spread with butter and pressed into hundreds and thousands, cut into stars with a cutter and piled high for the party.Soften 100g butter until very spreadable.Spread it right to the edges of 12 slices soft white bread.Tip 1 jar hundreds and thousands onto a plate and press each slice butter side down into them so the top is fully coated.Cut out stars with a large star cutter, or cut into triangles with the crusts off.Pile onto a platter and serve straight away so the colours don't run.MainsEduardo's chicken enchiladasShredded chicken rolled in tortillas under a red chilli sauceHow to make it800g chicken thighs4 dried chillies1 can crushed tomatoes8 flour tortillas200g cheddar300ml sour creamToast the chillies in a dry pan, soak in hot water, then blend with the tomatoes.Simmer the chicken in the sauce, then shred it.Roll the chicken in tortillas and place in a dish.Cover with more sauce and grated cheddar.Bake at 190°C.Serve with sour cream.Gru's lab spaghetti and meatballsSpaghetti, with Kevin locked in the labHow to make itAs written, serves 4Spaghetti and beef meatballs simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, a big pot for the whole household.Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g grated parmesan, 2 crushed garlic cloves and salt.Roll into 20 meatballs and brown in olive oil.Soften 1 diced onion, add 2 tins crushed tomatoes, a pinch of sugar and a handful of basil and simmer 15 minutes.Add the meatballs, cover and simmer 40 minutes.Toss with 500g cooked spaghetti and serve with plenty of parmesan.SweetsEvil purple minion jelly cupsGrape jelly with whipped cream and two banana slices on topHow to make it2 packets of grape jelly crystals150ml thickened cream2 bananasMake up the jelly as the packet says and pour into clear cups.Chill until set.Whip the cream and swirl on top.Add two banana slices to each like goggles.Gru's jelly tartsBerry jam tarts pastry into rounds and press into a patty tin.Fill with the jam.Bake at 190°C until the pastry is golden.DrinksMinion banana caramel smoothieFrozen banana, vanilla yoghurt, milk and dates, blended milk, yoghurt, pitted dates and cinnamon until thick.Drizzle caramel inside four glasses, pour in the smoothie and top with a banana slice.
